Zarr v.2 filters

Source: R/filters.R
zarr_filter.Rd

Zarr v.2 filters are transformations of chunk data that were not specified by Zarr v.2 itself but by the Numcodecs package that zarr-python uses. When a Zarr v.2 store is opened, the filters become codecs in the Zarr v.3 codec pipeline of an array, with a name of numcodecs.<id>. Because Zarr v.2 stores are read-only in this package, filters only decode data.

This class is the ancestor of all filters. It also implements the lossy "quantize" and "bitround" filters: these reduce the precision of floating point data upon encoding but they leave the data type unchanged, so decoding is the identity.

The following filters are supported: "delta", "fixedscaleoffset", "quantize", "bitround", "astype", "categorize", "packbits", "shuffle", "crc32", "adler32" and "fletcher32". The "vlen-utf8" filter is supported through zarr_codec_vlenutf8.

Super classes

zarr_extension -> zarr_codec -> zarr_filter

Active bindings

encoded_type

(read-only) The zarr_data_type of the encoded data, or NULL if the filter does not change the data type. This is the data type that the "bytes" codec must deserialize.

zarr_filter$new()

Create a new filter object.

Usage

zarr_filter$new(id, configuration, from = "array", to = "array")

Arguments

id

The Numcodecs identifier of the filter, such as "delta".

configuration

A list with the configuration parameters of the filter, as found in the Zarr v.2 metadata but without the "id" element.

from, to

The input and output data object for the encoding operation, either "array" or "bytes".

Returns

An instance of this class.

zarr_filter$copy()

Create a new, independent copy of this filter.

Usage

zarr_filter$copy()

Returns

An instance of the same class as this filter.

zarr_filter$encode()

Filters can only decode data: Zarr v.2 stores are read-only.

Usage

zarr_filter$encode(data)

Arguments

data

Ignored.

Returns

This method always throws an error.
